rag.content:
lemma update_eq_piecewise {β : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (f : ι → β) (i : ι) (v : β) :
    update f i v = piecewise (singleton i) (fun _ => v) f :=
  (piecewise_singleton (fun _ => v) _ _).symm

rag.content:
theorem univ_eq_singleton_of_card_one {α} [Fintype α] (x : α) (h : Fintype.card α = 1) :
    (univ : Finset α) = {x} := by
  symm
  apply eq_of_subset_of_card_le (subset_univ {x})
  apply le_of_eq
  simp [h, Finset.card_univ]

namespace WickContraction

open FieldSpecification HepLean.List FieldSpecification.FieldOpAlgebra FieldStatistic

variable {𝓕 : FieldSpecification} {n : ℕ} (c : WickContraction n)
informal_statement: For indices \( i \) and \( j \) where \( i < j \), the singleton set defined by the pair \( \{i, j\} \) is equal to \( \{i, j\} \).
informal_proof: Let \( i \) and \( j \) be indices such that \( i < j \). Consider the singleton set defined by the pair \( \{i, j\} \). By the properties of singleton sets and the given condition \( i < j \), we can conclude that the singleton set is exactly \( \{i, j\} \). This follows directly from the definition of singleton sets and the ordering of \( i \) and \( j \).

id.name: WickContraction.of_singleton_eq
id.content:
lemma of_singleton_eq {i j : Fin n} (hij : i < j) (a : (singleton hij).1) :
    a = ⟨{i, j}, mem_singleton hij⟩ := by
  have ha2 := a.2
  rw [@mem_singleton_iff] at ha2
  exact Subtype.coe_eq_of_eq_mk ha2
